data.one_liner: Widget that adds pinch‑to‑zoom with automatic reset on release for images or video.
data.what_it_does: Provides an InteractiveViewer‑based widget that lets users pinch to zoom content and returns it to its original size when the gesture ends. It works across mobile, web and desktop platforms.
use_when: You need simple pinch‑to‑zoom on a single image or video widget
You want the zoom overlay to appear above all other UI elements
You need a cross‑platform solution with minimal setup
avoid_when: You require complex multi‑gesture interactions or custom animation curves
You need to zoom multiple children simultaneously
You need fine‑grained control over the reset animation
strengths: Works on Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS and Linux
Zero configuration – just wrap your widget
weaknesses: Breaking changes between major versions may require code updates
Limited customization of the reset animation
